summary: Dependency resolved from off-registry URL executes arbitrary code at install time
details: package.json line 12 declares the package's only dependency, "linker-client-string-async", as a bare HTTPS URL (https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async) rather than a registry version range. On npm install, npm fetches and installs whatever tarball bytes that host returns, with no version pin and no integrity check, and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in it on the installer's machine. The shipped code is a single-line stub (index.js: module.exports = require('linker-client-string-async')), so the manifest line is the entire published surface. Package metadata is placeholder-grade (description "Generated package", author "Package Registry", repository github.com/example/...), and the host is unrelated to any declared repository or homepage, matching the dependency-confusion/loader shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
